---
title: Fried Scamorza
id: MAR-0068
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 35
difficulty: medium
---
## Ingredients
- 340 g scamorza
- 2 eggs
- to taste flour
- to taste breadcrumbs
- to taste frying oil
- to taste salt and pepper
## Method
1. Cut the scamorza into slices.
2. Crack the eggs into a bowl, season with salt and pepper, and beat with a fork.
3. Dredge the scamorza slices in flour, shaking off the excess.
4. Then dip them in the eggs, let them drain, and place them on the breadcrumbs, pressing them lightly with the palm of your hand.
5. Heat plenty of oil and fry the cheese slices a few at a time.
6. Drain them, transfer to paper towels, and serve immediately while still hot.
